column3: Boot failed is a full screen that reads POST /v1/repair (no body) for the failure and the journal/checkpoint counts. It offers Check again; Drop the journal ({drop: journal}) only when a checkpoint exists to rewind to; and Start from empty behind a typed word, which is {drop: journal} when there is no checkpoint and {drop: all} otherwise
column4: those are the only repair actions src/host.ts supports. With no checkpoint, dropping the journal empties pi exactly as dropping both does (XIN-23 reproduced it), so it is never worded as a rewind. Since #16 the home authorizes repair itself and a rotated token works on a home that failed to boot, so a 401 from repair means signed out and goes to sign-in
